Privacy Concerns Rise Over AI-Powered Wearable Technology

AI-powered wearable devices, such as smart glasses and AI pins, are facing growing privacy concerns that could hinder their adoption. The features that make these devices useful also pose risks to user privacy. In London, there is a notable pushback against smart glasses, with calls to "turn the cameras off."
